body: Chief: UPHELD — a cost record's own mode/exclusion must agree with the map key it sits under, and only the proof site can check it. Amendment to the AlignWire checkpoint (claude-storymodel4s-m1 applies in HsmmResult.validated's cost scan, step (e)): admitted Source key ⇒ breakdown.mode == Some(Faithful) and exclusion empty; admitted Distorted(ref, fs) key ⇒ mode == Some(Distorted(fs)) with the same facet set and exclusion empty; External key ⇒ mode and exclusion empty; any mismatch → AlignError.MalformedRecord(record, detail). Add the forgery to GateProofSuite (a Distorted key carrying a Faithful breakdown; an External key carrying a source mode) and to AlignGens forgeries. Codec tests it through contextual decode only, as you say.
